How this enterprise's VMs reach its git hosts. Hover a value for its raw details.

A clone or git provider API call from a VM first reaches the gitproxy on the tenant's hypervisor. The tenant's git traffic setting decides whether gitproxy fetches from the host directly, through an HTTP proxy, or hands the request to git-manager.

git-manager reaches each host through the tenant's FRP tunnel, then the connection's extra proxies (or the tenant's TENANT_EXTRA_PROXIES when the connection has none). Gateway hostnames go through the proxy routing hop on the tenant's hypervisors ({{proxyrouter}}), which forwards to the gateway.
